title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
note: Companion to OWASP AI Exchange focused on application-layer LLM risks. Referenced in several Stage 3 controls.

title: OWASP Agentic AI Threats and Mitigations
note: OWASP working group output specifically on agentic systems. Maps cleanly to AISMM Stage 3 agent-identity work.

title: NIST AI 600-1: Generative AI Profile
note: Applied companion to NIST AI RMF 1.0 covering generative AI risks and suggested actions.

title: MITRE ATLAS
note: Adversarial Threat Landscape for AI Systems. ATT&CK-style technique taxonomy for AI.

title: MITRE ATLAS Navigator
note: Coverage-tracking tool over the ATLAS matrix. Same workflow as ATT&CK Navigator.

title: OWASP AI Red Teaming Guide
note: Methodology and test cases for AI red teaming.

title: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions
note: Vendor-neutral conventions for logging and tracing GenAI invocations. Cited under Stage 3 structured logging.

title: EU AI Act explorer
note: Independent explorer over the EU AI Act text. Used here for article-level citations.

title: FAIR Institute (Factor Analysis of Information Risk)
note: Quantitative risk methodology. Stage 4 references FAIR extended for AI scenarios.

title: CIS AI Large Language Models Companion Guide
note: Model layer: prompts, context handling, sensitive data exposure. Source for the data handling and content exclusion primitives in Tool Baselines.

title: CIS AI Agents Companion Guide
note: Agent layer: tool execution, governed autonomy, access to enterprise systems. Source for the autonomy, sandbox, and policy primitives in Tool Baselines.

title: OWASP Secure Coding with AI Cheat Sheet
note: Coding-agent trust boundaries, hallucinated packages, repository content as untrusted input, MCP least privilege.

title: SANS Critical AI Security Guidelines
note: Six control categories: access controls, data protection, deployment strategies, inference security, monitoring, GRC.
